audit_kind: delta re-audit of the remediation commit against the previous receipt (ES-1..ES-8 verification)

remediation.evidence: now “La app no abre enlaces a tu propia máquina ni a tu red local.”; machine = máquina matches ui.mesh (esta máquina) and no longer collides with equipo = team.
now “No se borraron las marcas de mensajes sin leer.”; unread is “sin leer” as in the sibling arms and ui.teamBridge.
all three now use “Se hizo pull de …”; pull is the glossary's wave-2 kept-English hub operation and matches ui.hub.subscriptions.pull “Pull ahora”.
the plural now fixes two keys but breaks the single-key case; see findings[0] and render.es4_single_key.
now “El guardado de … falló ({keys})”; definite refusal, distinct from unconfirmed's “no se pudo confirmar”.
all nine now format the number with {count, number}; no bare {count} remains anywhere in the file (0 occurrences); rendered 1.000.000 / 1.000.001 confirm es grouping.
many arm added to all three; at 1.000.000 each renders “1.000.000 de chats …”, matching mark_all_read_cleared's “de” rule.
now preterite “no se pudo confirmar” and “se avisó al agente”, matching agents.save_unconfirmed and the namespace's receipts.

findings.current: Guardado: {keys}. Se inyectan en cada comando de bash como variables de entorno; el agente no puede leer el valor.
findings.proposed: Guardado: {keys}. Cada clave se inyecta en cada comando de bash como variable de entorno; el agente no puede leer el valor.
findings.reason: ES-4 asked for the multi-key case to stop being ungrammatical; the remediation made the verb and noun plural, which fixes two keys but is ungrammatical for the single key that the common single-paste path stores and renders (storedNotice is called whenever carried.stored.length > 0; the head renders “Guardado: OPENAI_API_KEY. Se inyectan … como variables de entorno”). A distributive clause agrees with both one and many without needing a count placeholder.

checks.detail: 94 en keys, 94 es keys, no missing, no extra, identical order; all seven locales carry the new key.

Parsed all 94 values with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser: argument-name sets equal to English for 94/94; the nine changed plurals keep {count} as the selector and format it with {count, number}; credentials.* keep {keys}.

checks.check: plural categories are the locale's CLDR set
checks.detail: Ten es plural messages; every one selects from one/many/other (no few/two). Intl.PluralRules('es') at 1/2/1000000/1000001 returns one/other/many/other, and the rendered output follows the same categories.

checks.check: plural category parity vs the English arms
checks.detail: Every English arm has an es counterpart; the extra many arm is the documented es addition (exact multiples of 10^6).
Rendered through the repo's real t() with es: grouping appears only from 1000 (1.000.000; 1.000.001), 1 and 2 stay bare, and the many/other split puts “de” only on exact millions (see render matrix).

checks.result: PASS for drafts, archive and mark-all-read
checks.detail: “1 borrador descartado.” → “1.000.000 de borradores descartados.”; ““Informe trimestral” archivada.” / “Conversación archivada.”; the mark-all-read receipt joins lead + up to three remainder sentences with spaces and reads correctly at all four counts.
tú throughout the changed values (tu propia máquina, ya tienes, Vuelve a pegar); no usted/vosotros.

team = equipo; machine = máquina; pull kept English; credentials = credenciales; unread = sin leer. The credentials one arms were byte-checked (sha256 894979babc0457aa for “1 credencial”, base64 MSBjcmVkZW5jaWFs) because the tool display redacts that noun.
“ ” quotes (including the new archive title), no space before : ; ? !, em dash with spaces where present, full stops intact.
No value equals its English source except the new archive_offered_title, whose value is only the locale's own “ ” pair around {title} and is allowlisted in locale-parity.test.mjs with that reason.

No changed string is materially longer than its English source beyond the locale's normal 15-25% expansion; all are toast-card sentences, and the context sidecars specify no maxCells for this namespace.

node --test scripts/i18n/locale-parity.test.mjs: 44/44 pass (all seven locales). typed-keys + context-parity + es-activation: 17/17 pass, including “keys.gen.ts is byte-identical to a fresh generation” and the real es t() activation.

render.tool: intl-messageformat 12.1.3, Node v24.22.1, ICU 78.3; rendered through the repo's own t() (esbuild bundle of src/i18n/messages) with locale set to es
